jobs.description:
Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Health and Safety Manager. As the Health and Safety Manager you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area. 
You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear. You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. As AWS increases data capacity you will partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.
This role is for an experienced Safety Specialist or Safety Engineer. The role's prime responsibility will be to support the safety operations for Data Centers. You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives. You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or public speaking forums. You will advise, instruct and train company personnel on safety policies and procedures, as well as assist the teams in incorporating and improving our safety standards at their sites. You will report to the Regional Safety Manager – EMEA and be responsible for continuing to enhance the safety of operations and construction. Some domestic and international travel is required. 
Key job responsibilities
Implement safety standards, policies and best practices.
Provision and Management of Training: Induction, Refresher Training as required, develop and deliver training/presentations to support achievement of H&S objectives. Ensure all H&S training requirements are fulfilled.
Collaborate with vendors (General Contractors, sub-contractors, Emergency Services) as they relate to operations and construction.
Ensure compliance and implementation of global safety programs and local regulatory legislation. 
Develop and review safety plans for on-site emergencies, special events and other unique safety situations.
Perform safety data analysis and create bench marking.
Ensure safety record keeping and provide accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
Consult and work with compliance teams on safety regulations interpretations and investigations. 
Develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to risks and prevent injury.
Adapt to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, strategy and deadlines. 
Able to work as part of a team and provide safety support to regions outside of local cluster when required.
Other duties as assigned.

About the team
We’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. 
Basic qualifications
Minimum 5+ years of field experience in in a Health & Safety role within operational environments. 
Fluent English language skill required (written and verbal communication). 
Valid driver's license.
Ability to work on-site at office and Data Center locations.

Preferred qualifications
Considerable knowledge of local safety and health regulatory laws and practices and workplace safety. 
Experience / knowledge of implementing safety programs, processes, and procedural documentation. 
Data center, manufacturing, construction, or similar industry safety experience with mix of full-time employees and third-party contractors.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.

jobs.occupation: Radiographer – Daytime position in coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:
30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and beginning work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is:
31,100 SEK/month gross
The salary as an authorised radiographer may be individually determined depending on previous professional experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
Please submit:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates
Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

Interested?
If you are a qualified radiographer interested in building a long-term career and life in Sweden, we would be happy to hear from you.
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:

Job description:This is a senior and independent leadership position with responsibility for establishing global verification and validation practices across Surface Mining Automation. You will have a unique opportunity to influence technology decisions, quality standards, and release readiness across a portfolio of strategic automation programs.
 At Epiroc, we're accelerating the transformation of mining through automation and digitalization. As our Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will play a key role in ensuring that our solutions are safe, predictable, compliant, and ready to deliver value for our customers around the world.
 Join our team
 You will be part of Surface Mining R&D Automation, a globally connected organization developing autonomous and software-defined mining solutions. Together with colleagues across R&D, Systems Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Release Management, we create innovative technologies that improve safety, productivity, and sustainability in mining operations.
 Your mission
 As Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will establish and lead a global approach to verification and validation, helping ensure the successful delivery of automation solutions across regions and programs.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Defining and continuously improving a global verification and validation strategy aligned with the V-model.
  Leading system- and machine-level verification activities across integrated automation solutions.
 Establishing clear release-readiness criteria, quality gates, and data-driven decision frameworks.
 Ensuring traceability from requirements to verification results, supported by robust documentation and compliance processes.
 Collaborating with engineering teams to identify risks early and improve solution quality from the start.
 Enabling scalable verification through reusable test methods, assets, and environments including HiL, SIL, and virtual testing.
 Supporting FAT/SAT activities and customer acceptance processes.
 Developing global V&V capabilities, common ways of working, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous improvement.

 You are comfortable making informed decisions based on data and evidence while supporting others in finding solutions to complex challenges.
 To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:
  Experience in system-level verification and validation within automation, embedded systems, control systems, software-intensive products, or system integration.
 Strong leadership experience in global or cross-functional environments, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders.
 Strong experience leading change management initiatives, including organizational, process, or technology transformations and driving adoption across global teams.The ability to communicate effectively at both strategic and operational levels, translating complex technical topics into clear business insights while building strong relationships with engineering teams.
 A strong focus on quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
 Knowledge of verification strategies, requirements traceability, system integration, release processes, and verification environments such as HiL, SIL, or simulation-based testing.
 Experience with customer acceptance activities, field-deployed automation, compliance, or functional safety is considered an advantage.
 A degree in Engineering or a related technical field. Advanced studies and leadership development experience are welcome.
 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.
You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Jondal
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life between the fjord, mountains and glacier
Jondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

Location: Skåne, Sweden
 Employment: Full-time, permanent position
 Salary: SEK 34,470–38,000 gross per month
 Accommodation: May be available by agreement
 Start date: By agreement
About BM Showjumping AB
BM Showjumping AB is a professional equestrian business based in Skåne, Sweden, specialising in showjumping horses.
We are seeking an experienced, responsible and highly motivated Yard Manager to oversee the daily running of our equestrian facilities and the management, care and welfare of approximately 10–20 horses.
This is a key position within our business, combining practical horse management, stable operations, staff supervision and the organisation of our competition activities.
We are looking for someone who has substantial experience with competition horses, understands the demands of a professional showjumping environment and can take responsibility for maintaining the highest standards throughout the yard.
Main duties and responsibilities
1. Horse management and welfare
Taking overall responsibility for the daily care and management of 10–20 horses.
Organising feeding, watering, bedding, grooming and general horse care.
Monitoring the health, fitness, condition and welfare of each horse.
Arranging and coordinating veterinary, farrier and other specialist appointments.
Identifying potential health problems and ensuring appropriate action is taken.
Managing horse turnout, stable routines and individual care requirements.

2. Stable and yard management
Managing the day-to-day operation of the stable and equestrian facilities.
Maintaining clean, safe and well-organised stables, paddocks and working areas.
Managing feed, bedding, equipment and other supplies.
Organising daily work schedules and stable routines.
Overseeing routine maintenance and ensuring facilities are maintained to a high standard.

3. Staff supervision and organisation
Supervising and coordinating stable staff.
Allocating daily duties and monitoring the quality of work.
Ensuring staff follow established procedures for horse care and welfare.
Organising workloads around training, competitions and other operational requirements.
Maintaining a positive, professional and productive working environment.

4. Riding and competition preparation
Riding and exercising horses in accordance with their individual training requirements and ability.
Assisting with the preparation of horses for showjumping competitions.
Coordinating competition schedules and transport arrangements.
Ensuring horses are appropriately prepared and cared for before and after competitions.
Understanding the particular needs of competition horses and maintaining their fitness and wellbeing.

5. Administration and business operations
Maintaining daily records relating to horse care, health and stable activities.
Coordinating veterinary and farrier bookings.
Managing stock levels and ordering feed, bedding and supplies.
Assisting with scheduling, planning and general business administration.
Reporting operational issues and contributing to the efficient running of the business.

Experience and qualifications
Applicants must demonstrate:
Significant professional experience working with horses.
Previous experience managing or supervising an equestrian yard or stable.
Strong knowledge of horse health, welfare, feeding and stable management.
Experience with competition horses, preferably showjumping horses.
Practical riding experience and the ability to exercise horses appropriately.
Experience organising staff and managing daily operational responsibilities.
Good organisational, administrative and communication skills.
The ability to work independently and take responsibility for decisions.
A reliable, flexible and hardworking attitude.

A full driving licence is desirable. Experience driving horseboxes and transporting competition horses is an advantage.
Formal equestrian qualifications are desirable, although substantial relevant professional experience will also be considered.
Language requirements
Good spoken and written English is required.

Employment conditions
Full-time employment.
Gross monthly salary of SEK 34,470–38,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
Working hours agreed in the employment contract.
Holiday entitlement in accordance with Swedish legislation.
Employment-related insurance and occupational pension arrangements.
Accommodation may be available by separate agreement.
Working arrangements will reflect the requirements of a professional equestrian business, including reasonable weekend and competition-period responsibilities.

All employment conditions will comply with applicable Swedish employment legislation and the relevant collective agreement or established industry practice.
International applicants
BM Showjumping AB welcomes applications from experienced international candidates, including applicants from outside the EU/EEA who require a Swedish work permit.
The company is prepared to participate in the Swedish Migration Agency's employer-led work-permit application process for a suitable candidate.
Any appointment will be conditional upon the necessary work and residence permissions being granted.
How to apply
Please submit a CV and covering letter outlining your professional equestrian experience, previous yard-management responsibilities and relevant qualifications.
Please include:
Your current country of residence.
Your experience with showjumping and competition horses.
Your previous experience managing a stable or supervising staff.
Your riding experience and qualifications.

jobs.occupation: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch, a world leader in the field of software for advanced radiation therapy, is now looking for a Sales Operations Administrator to strengthen our international Sales team.
About the position
In this role, you will play a key part in our Sales organization, supporting efficient and well-structured sales operations across global markets. You will work closely with the sales process by supporting the end-to-end customer licensing lifecycle, helping ensure that our teams have the tools, data, and processes needed to succeed.
You will act as a key point of contact for our organization regarding license issuance, renewals, verifications, and compliance. Your goal is to ensure a smooth, accurate, and customer-focused experience while maintaining adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
As one of our CRM experts, you will be responsible for data integrity within our CRM system and guaranteeing that all licensing documentation remains accurate, complete, and fully compliant. By ensuring accurate insights and reliable system structures, you will support business decisions and contribute to the continued growth of RaySearch.
You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Sales, Service, R&D, and Quality departments in an international and dynamic environment.
Your main tasks:
Process customers’ license applications, renewals, upgrades, transfers, etc., in a timely and accurate manner
Be an expert of the licensing structure and provisioning at RaySearch
Work with data quality, structure and management of data in Salesforce
Follow up and monitor documentation about our customers
Submit information to RaySearch’s global sales network (direct sales and distribution network)

Your profile
To succeed in this role, you have strong communication and administrative skills combined with an analytical and structured mindset. You are a fast learner that understands complex concepts and ideas. You are detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to maintaining high-quality data and documentation.
You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, can manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines. An adaptable team member who readily supports the group through peak periods.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong customer-service orientation.
We would like to see that you have:
Relevant university degree or equivalent education
1-3 years experience in sales support, business operations, or CRM administration
Hands-on proficiency with CRM software platforms, specifically Salesforce
Advanced capabilities in Microsoft Office Suite
Very strong organizational and administrative skills
Excellent written and spoken skills in English and Swedish

Good knowledge in other languages are considered a merit. It is also an advantage (but not required) if you have experience from a software company, medical devices or healthcare industries.
Our Culture 
Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care. 
Our Offer 
At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package. 
Application

About the job
As Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and strengthening Alfa Laval's relationship with one of its key strategic energy customers in Norway. Based in the Service Sales team within the Energy Division, you will take a holistic view of the customer relationship and identify opportunities across both Service Sales and Capital Sales.
 
You will turn customer insight into commercial opportunities by understanding the customer's business priorities, mapping stakeholders and building trusted relationships at every level, from maintenance and technical teams to senior and executive management. Working closely with Alfa Laval's Business Units, Capital Sales, Service Sales and Nordic service organization, you will develop and execute a long-term account strategy that supports sustainable growth.

Conduct market and customer analysis to identify business potential, customer priorities and growth opportunities.
Map the customer's organization, stakeholders and decision-making processes across relevant business areas and locations.
Develop account strategies that define which relationships to build, with whom and for what purpose.
Develop and maintain a two- to four-year Key Account Management plan, including customer segmentation, prioritization and commercial objectives.
Identify opportunities across the full customer lifecycle, including service agreements, maintenance, upgrades, replacements, new equipment and capital projects.
Develop, implement and follow up local sales activities with relevant customer stakeholders and markets to achieve sustainable growth.
Develop a close relationship between Sales and Service Operations to ensure projects are executed according to plan and meet customer expectations.
Plan and coordinate customer engagement to ensure that the right stakeholders are involved at the right time.
Systematically follow up each stage of the KAM sales process to ensure that relevant opportunities are identified and captured.
Proactively coordinate with Alfa Laval Business Units, Capital Sales, Service Sales, service operation and other internal stakeholders to ensure aligned customer and market strategies.

 
This position is preferably located in Norway and reports to David Mellby, Market Area Manager for the Nordic Sales Company serving the Energy Division.
 
Who are you
You are a customer-focused and strategic relationship builder who enjoys understanding complex organizations and turning customer insight into action. You are proactive and confident in reaching out to stakeholders at every level, including senior management, while remaining equally comfortable discussing practical challenges with maintenance and technical teams. You adapt your communication style to different audiences and functions, create momentum without waiting to be asked, and influence through open dialogue and collaboration. Structured and accountable, you follow through on commitments and are motivated by creating sustainable growth across both service and capital sales.
 
What you know
To succeed in this role, you combine proven commercial experience with the ability to understand technical products, service offerings, capital projects and complex stakeholder environments. We believe that our ideal candidate has:
A minimum of 5-7 years of proven experience in B2B sales, Key Account Management or Business Development.
Strong understanding of customer segmentation, stakeholder mapping and consultative selling.
Experience selling technical products, solutions or services, preferably within the industrial or energy sectors in the Northern European market.
Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to assess business potential and prioritize opportunities.
Experience working with CRM systems and digital sales tools.
A clear commitment to safety as a core priority in all customer and commercial activities
Fluency in English and one Nordic language, preferably Norwegian.
A degree in business, sales, engineering, industrial technology or a related field.
Experience from the oil and gas / offshore industry is an advantage.
